gctx · keys                                                 j/k scroll · esc or ? to close
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  navigation                             actions
  j/↓          next row                  enter   switch to selected account
  k/↑          previous row              /       filter
  g/home       first row                 esc     clear applied filter
  G/end        last row                  d/i     details
  ctrl+f/pgdn  page down                 l       login
  ctrl+b/pgup  page up                   L       login every stale account
  tab          next provider tab         s       subshell with every active slot
  shift+tab    previous provider tab     S       subshell with only this account
  1-9          jump to tab (1 is All)    y       copy the env eval line
                                         r       run gcloud command
  view                                   c       create account
  p  toggle detail pane                  e       edit account
  z  fold or unfold the provider group   ctrl+d  delete account
  !  only rows needing action            a       save current ADC to selected account
  o  cycle sort: name, status, expiry
                                         general
                                         R         reload
                                         ?         help
                                         q/ctrl+c  quit
                                         :         command palette

  providers
  GCP          gcloud 540.0.0   ✓ global switch · ADC
  AWS          aws 2.27.4       ✓ env: AWS_PROFILE
  Azure        az 2.75.0        ✓ env: AZURE_CONFIG_DIR
